overlayEntry.notes: srUSD is Reservoir's yield-bearing savings wrapper over rUSD (daily interest accrual; micro burn fee of one day's interest on redemption); the rUSD backing basket carries the credit-fund exposure, so the shared protocol balance sheet is what is measured. Live on-chain reserves API (app.reservoir.xyz/api/reserves/raw, fetched 2026-07-27T22:52Z): totalAssets $35,590,379.25 versus totalLiabilities $35,293,416.95 (wsrUSD $34,375,887.13, srUSD $714,584.80, rUSD circulating $202,945.02) leaves $296,962.30 equity, a measured system collateralization of 1.008414 (100.84%). Asset composition: 45.16% Morpho Sentora PRIME (Figure-originated HELOC private credit), 25.69% Pendle PT-USDat-27AUG2026, 11.35% Aave GHO (Plasma), 9.53% Morpho Steakhouse Prime Instant V2 (USDC), 4.17% Aave GHO (Monad), 3.65% Agua Global Carry ERC-4626 vault, 0.34% Hastra PRIME RWA, 0.10% direct USDC. On-chain anchor at Ethereum block 25627264 (ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, eth_call totalSupply 0x18160ddd): srUSD totalSupply 620,109.556 shares at 0x738d1115B90efa71AE468F1287fc864775e23a31; the API's $714,584.80 srUSD liability implies ~1.1523 USD per share, consistent with documented yield accrual. weightedAverageMaturityDays 7.9647 treats the on-demand-redeemable lending/vault/stablecoin sleeves (74.31%) as 0-day and the 25.69% Pendle PT sleeve at its documented fixed maturity 2026-08-27 (31 days from the 2026-07-27 read), matching the wsrusd-reservoir precedent methodology; the 45.16% Sentora PRIME sleeve's underlying HELOC maturities are issuer-undisclosed and conservatively treated as 0-day. valuationCadenceDays 0 reflects the continuously readable on-chain balance sheet. All seven components are graded limited: the issuer publishes itemized structured reserve data (API with per-position values) corroborated by verifiable external anchors (on-chain supply reads, Aave/Morpho market links, verified contracts), which is the D3 limited evidence class; adequate would require a dated independent attestation, regulatory filing, or Chronicle-class oracle covering the component, and none exists (Reservoir's five Halborn audits are smart-contract code audits, not reserve attestations; no named attestor, accountant, or fund administrator appears in docs.reservoir.xyz). NOT ESTABLISHED: no external credit rating or per-obligor credit quality for the DeFi/RWA positions (creditQuality limited); seniority rests on the smart-contract Credit Enforcer covenants (documented ~105% minimum liquidity/asset/equity ratios) and the $296,962 measured equity buffer, not on any legal seniority instrument, and the documented 105% minimums could not be independently confirmed against the measured 100.84% live collateralization (seniority limited); no legal SPV, trust, or bankruptcy-remote claim wrapper for srUSD holders — enforcement is smart-contract only (legalEnforceability limited); NAV is self-administered through asset adapters with no independent administrator or attestor (valuationCadence limited); srUSD exits to rUSD and rUSD redemption is documented as subject to available PSM liquidity (USDC PSM auto-maintained at 25-50bps of total assets, hourly refill) rather than a guaranteed at-par redemption (maturityAndLiquidity limited); the balance sheet sits in protocol-controlled Asset Adapter/PSM contracts with no third-party custodian (custody limited); and the only loss-absorption layer is the thin measured protocol equity plus covenant constraints, with no unconditional recapitalization commitment (recovery limited).
